speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start by describing your cough: how long has it been going on, and does it produce any sputum? If so, what color is it?

speaker: Patient
text: My cough has been going on for about three weeks and it started right after I had a cold. It's pretty productive, mostly in the mornings, and the sputum is yellowish. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-viral bronchitis with confirmed Cushing's syndrome. The yellowish sputum and three-week duration follow a viral illness, while the elevated urinary cortisol confirms the endocrine disorder.
